content: AUTOSAR shall use hardware communication data integrity mechanisms Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR shall use data integrity mechanisms which are offered by communication hardware such that major fault models described i n ISO 26262 are covered Requirements on AUTOSAR Features AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 71 of 87 Document ID 294 : AUTOSAR_RS _Features Rationale: Cover the ISO26262 cases like: - Loss of communication peer - Message corruption - Message unacceptable delay - Message loss - Unintended message repetition - Incorrect sequencing of messages - Message insertion - Message masquerading - Message incorrect addressing Use Case: Exchanging of information between elements executed on different ECUs including signals, data, messages, etc. Information can be exchanged using I/O - devices, data busses, etc. Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: ISO 26262 - 5:201 8 Annex D, ISO 26262 - 6:201 8 Annex D
